This episode ranks five nations where daily life has become particularly difficult. From South Africa's crime and unemployment crisis to Argentina's economic instability, Zimbabwe's hyperinflation under Mugabe, Venezuela's collapse under Maduro, and Haiti's gang violence and poverty, the video examines how colonialism, corruption and mismanagement have squandered each country's potential.

This video is #sponsored by Surfshark.
title: Worst Countries to Live In — Ranked
